description: Write the free-surface rilling history of the current run to the comma-delimited file s (default rillReport.csv). One row per solve day on which rilling moved at least one marker, with columns Day (solve day), RillSwaps (solid/air marker exchanges performed by the rilling logic that day) and RillColumns (distinct block columns whose air gap received material that day). Days without rilling are not listed.
notes: The history is accumulated during 'massflow compute', cleared by 'model new', and archived in the save file (survives model save / model restore).
A per-day summary can also be printed to the console while solving with 'massflow initialize rill-log on'.
Which individual markers were moved by rilling, and when, is in the RillCount and LastRillDay columns of the marker report ('massflow marker report-export').
With no rilling recorded the file is still written; the echo reports '(0 rilling days, 0 swaps total)'.
New with 9.8: absent from the 9.7-era corpus sweep; present in the 9.8.54 manual and build.
verification: Live-verified 2026-11-10 on MassFlow 9.8.54 (GUI bridge) (state grade): bare form wrote rillReport.csv and "massflow rill-report 'probe_rill.csv'" wrote the named file; both echoed '(0 rilling days, 0 swaps total)' on an empty run.
